notes_for_editor: The only text describing the tower is a copy of a 1951 Coast and Geodetic Survey description on the Central US Lookouts page. The NGS listing for EK0869 gives no full datasheet (the listing says complete data sheets were not provided), so the 1951 text was not checked against an NGS datasheet. The listing's trailing codes (XX on one row, NN on another) are not explained for this station; in the listing's code key X means surface mark reported destroyed and N means no geodetic control, so the survey mark may be reported destroyed. A reviewer should check this before publication. Record coordinates agree with the NGS listing to about 30 m. Search results named a Lockesburg water tower (1936) and Bethel places elsewhere in Arkansas, but no Sevier County lookout record or 1951 tower record; none used. The story says lookout tower only, since no source calls it a fire tower. Worth checking Arkansas Forestry Commission or Sevier County historical records for build date, use and fate.
